notes: Played at the 2001 Massachusetts State Championship; the post says it went 1-2 (+4).

Starting cards as posted under 'General Starting (9)': My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive (posted 'MKOS/FI'), Tatooine: Desert Heart, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Well Guarded, Prepared Defenses, No Bargain, Power Of The Hutt, Secret Plans ('very subject to change') and Amanaman (the representative); these count toward the 60. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.
Posted 'Amanaman x3 (plus 1 starting)': four Amanaman in all (1 starting + 3).

Posted 'Jabba (SE)' dested Jabba (Special Edition card); 'Galid' dested Gailid; '4-Lom w/ Gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'CC Engineer' dested Cloud City Engineer; 'Abyssian Ornament/Wounded Wookiee' dested Abyssin Ornament & Wounded Wookiee; 'Ghhk/These Rebels Won't Escape Us' dested Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'Scum + Villany' dested Scum And Villainy; 'Den of Theives' dested Den Of Thieves; 'Twi'leck Advisor' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'Boba Fett in Slave 1' dested Boba Fett In Slave I.

Secret Plans and Resistance were Effects in 2001 (Special Edition / Jabba's Palace pages), not Defensive Shields; 'Something Special Planned For Them()' dested the Death Star II Effect, not the (V) card.
The lines 'Average Destiny Before Flip 3.5' / 'After 5.5' are deck statistics, not cards, and were dropped.
